personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A commit gate under a second and a push gate around ten seconds is something I will keep on; a red quick check on my draft beats finding out when I mark it ready.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: Hooks that block me are only worth it if they never cost minutes and say exactly what to fix; failing closed on a broken install worries me.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Every agent graded the same way, drafts included, is the point I can defend to anyone comparing setups.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: Right direction, but a push hook that can run the whole suite will train people to skip it.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: I mostly read the PRs; a quick check on every sub-PR means the wave's merges stop being on trust.

objection.text: If the push hook ever costs minutes, my engineers will learn --no-verify and the gate protects nothing. Keep it to seconds.
